title: Code city
goal: Build a spatial mental model and select the next file to investigate.

title: Overview
goal: Understand independent health signals and decide where to inspect next.

title: Architecture
goal: Compare observed dependencies with explicitly intended boundaries.

title: Hotspots
goal: Prioritize investigation using transparent raw measurements.

title: Code quality
goal: Triage static findings with evidence, location, and a recorded disposition.

title: Test confidence
goal: Assess where tested execution is missing and keep assertion strength distinct from coverage.

title: Dependencies
goal: Inspect external package inventory separately from internal module architecture.

title: Security
goal: Review possible issues without presenting an unverified exploitability verdict.

title: Evolution
goal: Understand trends and change relationships rather than judging one snapshot.

title: Ownership
goal: Plan continuity and knowledge sharing at module/team level.

title: Refactor workbench
goal: Convert evidence into scoped, verifiable improvement work.

title: Audit report
goal: Communicate scope, evidence, limitations and proposed work clearly.

title: Data & scans
goal: Make source scope and provider provenance explicit before interpretation.

title: Settings
goal: Adjust real preview preferences while keeping production policies explicit.

title: File detail
goal: Follow a selected file from metrics to source context, evidence and planned changes.
